articles.title: Police investigating after stabbing victim found lying on the road in Scarborough
articles.summary: Toronto police are investigating after the victim of a stabbing was found lying on the road in Scarborough. Officers say the man was found in the area of Poplar and Kingston roads just before 6:30 a.m. Monday. The victim has been stabbed and was taken to hospital with non-life-threatening injuries. articles.title: Man suffers gunshot wound, Toronto police investigating possible shooting location
articles.summary: Toronto police are investigating where a shooting may have taken place after a man walked into a hospital with a gunshot wound. Police say the man walked into the hospital in the Finch Avenue and Arrow Road area just before 1 a.m. His injuries have been classified as non-life-threatening. No suspect information has been released […]

articles.summary: Some memories were made Sunday as a season to forget came to a close for the Toronto Blue Jays. articles.title: Police identify 2nd victim in separate vehicle fires within hours of each other in Etobicoke, Scarborough
articles.summary: Toronto police have identified a body that was found in a burning vehicle in Etobicoke last week shortly after another body was found in a burning vehicle in Scarborough.

articles.title: Walmart says it’s not using personal information to set prices as it expands digital shelf labels
articles.summary: NEW YORK (AP) — Walmart is aiming to assuage customers' fears about its new pricing technology as it rolls out digital price labels at its stores.

articles.title: Man in his 60s dead after crash in Brampton: Peel police
articles.summary: A man in his 60s has died after a two-vehicle crash in Brampton on Sunday morning, Peel police said.

articles.title: 57-year-old man dead, 1 arrested after stabbing in North York: police
articles.summary: A 57-year-old man is dead after a stabbing in North York on Saturday night, Toronto police said.

articles.title: York Region says Ontario underfunds its community services by $450 million annually
articles.summary: Community services in York Region are facing a "significant shortfall" due to receiving less funding from the Ontario government compared to other large municipalities for several years, according to a new report commissined by the region

articles.title: AFC Toronto earns NSL playoff berth with 3-0 win over Rapid
articles.summary: Lena Silano scored twice for AFC Toronto in a 3-0 blanking of Ottawa Rapid FC in the Northern Super League on Saturday at York Lions Stadium in Toronto.

articles.title: Burlington woman facing 65 new charges over slew of incidents at hospitals across Ontario: OPP
articles.summary: Ontario Provincial Police say a 34-year-old woman who was first arrested in May following complaints of theft and fraud at an Orillia hospital is now facing 65 new charges.

articles.title: Durham Region to hold 1st community event celebrating newcomers on Saturday
articles.summary: Durham Region is hosting its first community event on Saturday to celebrate the contributions newcomers make to the region.
